programme.desc: The defending champion Panthers visit the Hurricanes for Game 1 of the Eastern Conference finals. Florida advanced to its third straight Stanley Cup semifinal with a 6-1 victory over Toronto in Game 7. Carolina ousted Washington in five games.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Hurricanes try to level their series with the Panthers in Game 2 of the Eastern Conference finals. Florida converted two of its three power-play opportunities in Game 1 and Sergei Bobrovsky stopped 31 shots to secure a 5-2 victory over Carolina.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Panthers return home with a 2-0 series lead for Game 3 of the East final against the Hurricanes. Florida seized control with a 5-0 victory in Game 2. Conn Smythe Trophy contender Sergei Bobrovsky (FLA) recorded his third shutout this postseason.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Panthers try to blow away the Hurricanes in Game 4 of the East final. Defending Stanley Cup champion Florida broke a 1-1 tie with five goals in a 9:08 span of the third period en route to a 6-2 triumph in Game 3, and a commanding 3-0 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Hurricanes head back home to host the Panthers for Game 5 of the Eastern Conference finals. Frederik Andersen made 20 stops for his second shutout of the postseason as Carolina staved off elimination with a 3-0 victory over Florida in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: For the second straight season, the Stars and Oilers duel in the West finals, starting with Game 1. Edmonton vanquished Dallas in six games in 2024 for their first Stanley Cup Final berth since 2006. Dallas has made four of the last five West finals.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Oilers try to make sense of their West final against the Stars, down 1-0 entering Game 2. Edmonton led 3-1 after two periods in Game 1 before Dallas scored five unanswered goals in the third for a 6-3 victory. Tyler Seguin (DAL) scored twice.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The deadlocked Western Conference final shift to Canada for Game 3 between the Stars and Oilers. Edmonton tied the series at 1-1 with a 3-0 victory over Dallas in Game 2. Stuart Skinner stopped all 25 Stars shots after allowing five goals in Game 1.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Stars try to get even with the Oilers in Game 4 of the Western Conference finals. Edmonton leads the series 2-1 after an emphatic 6-1 victory in Game 3. Connor McDavid scored twice in that contest, giving him a postseason-most 22 points.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Oilers look to book a return trip to the Stanley Cup Final in Game 5 against the Stars. Edmonton set up the potential clinching contest with a 4-1 victory at home over Dallas in Game 4. Corey Perry (EDM) notched a goal and an assist in the win.

programme.desc: Po and team go to the city of Tikal to get more information on the Protector, but it's easier said than done, since nobody in the town actually knows the identity of the Protector. Blade becomes increasingly frustrated and Po attempts to help her.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. The game brings out a highly competitive and aggressive side to Blade, known as \"The Beast.\" Back in China, Colin and Weimin find the Pirate Queen and become part of her pirate crew.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh!
programme.desc: Tip starts dating Stick, but ruins the relationship when she tries to change him/Tip tries to impress the older kids at her first ninth grade party but, Oh's Boovy behavior embarrasses her.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh!
programme.desc: When Tip wants her nose pierced, Oh and the Boov become obsessed with modifying their bodies/Tip doesn't want to go to school anymore and discovers a shortcut to infinite knowledge.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T.
programme.desc: Turbo takes Beakless under his wing during a battle of snails vs. birds; Chet is Sheriff of a western Turbotown and fights a gang of outlaw crickets.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T.
programme.desc: Skidmark competes with rich snail Shellsworth to build a railroad; Turbo and Chet roadtrip with their trucker dad and protect their cargo from bandits.

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: When the crew is forced to spend a night in the desert to avoid a sandstorm, they wake up the next day without their most important parts.

programme.title: The Mr. Peabody And Sherman Show
programme.desc: While showing off their new teleportation suits, Peabody and Sherman accidentally teleport inside Orchoptitron without enough juice to teleport out.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Power Outage – Part 3: Escape from Scare School Things worsen when a leprechaun, Razznik, steals the magical cleptor that now holds all of Scare School's powers. Power Outage – Part 4: The Final Battle On a hunt for ghostly powers, the evil leprechaun orders Deedstown to hand over Casper's uncles, OR ELSE.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: When Fuse's collection of Special Things goes missing, Noddy vows to track them down. He soon works out that Bling was in Fuse's Workshop but it turns out that she just went in to add a Special Thing to Fuse's collection. More clues lead Noddy to Smartysaurus. She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there. Noddy begins to despair but then he works out that the oil can must have been left by whoever took the Special Things. Remembering that Pat-Pat's scooter was squeaky, Noddy goes to the Treehouse and finds the Pockets with Fuse's Special Things. They'd 'found' Fuse's Special Things and taken them to start a collection of their own. They apologies for taking the special things and, as a reward for owning up, Fuse gives them a tool from his workshop to start their own collection. Well done Noddy. Case closed!

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service
programme.desc: It's a snowy day in Greendale, and Ted Glen has invited the kids to his workshop to meet his friend, space expert Professor Farrow. Julian's excited but so is Pat, who has always yearned to be an astronaut. He's even more thrilled when he finds that his special delivery is a space suit - an extra surprise for the kids. When his van breaks down in a snowy lane, he finds an ingenious solution - only to suffer a puncture - and Ted is unable to help... Meanwhile, Professor Farrow and Lauren take the kids out into the snow and re-create the surface of the moon. Pat's determined to make his delivery, but how will he make it on foot through the snow? As the kids perfect their snowy “moon”, a space-suited figure approaches - Pat in the space suit. Mission Accomplished!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: It is the day of the annual Flowertot Race. Poppy is reluctant to enter as she always loses her way. Fifi and Bumble help her train for the big race, but will she win?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Raa Raa is in a playful mood and sets off to find his friends. Together they incorporate everybody's game, to make one noisy, fun filled new game.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because he’s missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. \\ When there’s a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, it’s up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they don’t have to forfeit.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On!

programme.title: A.B. Normal College
programme.desc: Brace yourself as the hilarious guys of A.B. Normal College bring chaos and fun to their university! Andres (Andrew E.), Dominic (Ogie Alcasid) and Miguel (Mikey Arroyo), the school's most notorious students, are challenged when the school participates in a quiz show to upgrade the image of the school.

programme.title: Indak
programme.desc: Vin (Sam Concepcion) invites a simple island girl, Jen (Nadine Lustre), to join Indak Pinas, a dance group, after her dance video goes viral. The two not only find their groove, but also slowly fall for each other.

programme.title: Roadtrip
programme.desc: After their friend’s death, four women set out on the dream trip they planned as teenagers, rekindling old bonds as they pay their last respects.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: When a former BlackRose cartel assassin deliberately betrays them by refusing to complete her mission, the cartel orders her execution. Unbeknownst to them, she fakes her own death and is able to create a new life of her own.

programme.title: It's Cool Bulol
programme.desc: Red Sternberg stars as a campus nerd who has always been wanting to be accepted for what he is. He's smart, alright, but in an environment where substance takes a backseat to style, he is everybody's favorite laughingstock.

programme.title: Masamang Ugat
programme.desc: Two brothers are separated after their mother dies. One becomes a cop (Mikey Arroyo), the other an assassin (Ace Vergel). The cop ambitiously wants to bring down a drug lord supported by politicians, while the assassin works for the same drug lord.

programme.title: Bakit Lahat ng Gwapo May Boyfriend?
programme.desc: Kylie (Anne Curtis), a wedding planner has had a long string of boyfriends. Unfortunately for her, they've all been gay.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Patayan Files: Ang Pinakamalaking Murder Cases ng Dekada '90
programme.desc: Cheche Lazaro's Probe Archives goes in depth on the controversy behind the gruesome crimes that shocked the entire country during the 90s.

programme.title: Chain Mail
programme.desc: A usual chain mail is forwarded to a group of people. Some pass it while others ignore. One dies and is followed by series of sudden and unexplainable deaths of others. Soon after, a revelation begins to unfold, the chain mail is cursed and so Sandra (Shy Carlos) has to find the origin and mystery behind to stop the misfortunes.

programme.title: Ang Kabit Ni Mrs. Montero
programme.desc: Ang Kabit Ni Mrs. Montero tells the story of a young, beautiful wife (Patricia Javier) who’s wealthy but paraplegic husband (Edu Manzano) cannot provide her the physical intimacy she desires.

programme.title: Pedro Penduko Episode 2 (The Return of the Comeback)
programme.desc: He is descendant of a Legendary hero, but for the young Pedro Penduko (Janno Gibbs) heroism in the silver screen is more appealing than real life bravado. But Pedro is not destined to be a movie star, he finds himself in the center of a kingdom in need of a hero.

programme.title: Pagdating ng Panahon
programme.desc: Lynette (Sharon Cuneta) is a conservative \u0026 religious lady who leads a boring life. So when she gets a marriage proposal from Manuel (Robin Padilla), whose family is known to be a brood of chauvinists, she was ecstatic.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: In what appears to be a serendipitous encounter upon saving the life of a stranger, the calculated and reserved businessman Nick (Aga Muhlach) meets the impulsive and optimistic photographer Ali (Bea Alonzo), who believes in destiny and carpe diem.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Wala Ka Nang Lupang Tatapakan
programme.desc: A soldier whose dedication to duty is unwavering, Daniel finds himself going against authority when his wife and son were murdered. With the local police unwilling to go after the perpetrator of the crime, Daniel decides to take matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Wangbu
programme.desc: Dodong (Jay Manalo) moves his family to Manila in search for a better life. But his dream for a brighter future starts crumbling when he catches his son sniffing solvent.

programme.title: Penduko
programme.desc: Hoping to profit from his occult gifts, a mystic joins a shadowy society and must confront his own darkness as he finds his place in the underworld.

programme.title: Shoot! Shoot! Di Ko Siya Titigilan!
programme.desc: When an aspiring actor practices his role as a billionaire out loud, gossip about him being rich spreads like wildfire. Now, the girls and the goons are after him.

programme.title: Camp Sawi
programme.desc: A group of brokenhearted women end up at a resort that specializes in helping people ease their pain.
Anton and Erika have been a couple for 12 years already. While he's not yet ready to get married, Erika waits until he is and lovingly devotes her time to him.

programme.title: Akala Mo
programme.desc: Rizette (Judy Ann Santos) is a lady guard and is hopelessly in love with Eric (Dingdong Dantes), one of the tenants in the condominium where she is stationed.

programme.title: Deception
programme.desc: A woman is released from jail ten years after she killed her husband. When she meets a guy that looks exactly as her husband, she starts to connect the dots linked to the night the murder happened.

programme.title: Katawan
programme.desc: The moment the doctor confirms his wife’s pregnancy, Carlo has felt the signs of a curse coming to life. It’s the curse that doomed his father. The same curse that’s about to destroy him.

programme.title: Pilak
programme.desc: Pilak.

programme.title: Ang Manananggal na Nahahati ang Puso
programme.desc: A barrio lass agrees to be the subject of a man's research about aswangs. He falls for her but hides his feelings knowing that she's an aswang.

programme.title: Akin Ang Labang Ito
programme.desc: Dario rescues a powerful syndicate head, Don Manolo, from an assassination attempt. Meanwhile, Carlo discovers the Don's business in drugs and he tries to quit.

programme.title: Momzillas
programme.desc: Clara and Minerva, the two women who shared the same man, meet again when their son and daughter, respectively, are about to marry each other.

programme.title: Habangbuhay
programme.desc: A sheltered girl, who grew up in a very protective family, is asking a boy to fight for their love. If only he was not too consumed by his own battles.

programme.title: Maid in Malacañang
programme.desc: The Last Days of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos tells the untold story of the last 72 hours of the Marcos dynasty.

programme.title: Roadtrip
programme.desc: After their friend’s death, four women set out on the dream trip they planned as teenagers, rekindling old bonds as they pay their last respects.

programme.title: Revirginized
programme.desc: Carmela (Sharon Cuneta) gets to enjoy life again in a wild beach party. With young people and a hunk tattoo artist, she drowns herself in alcohol to forget her current self and renew her old self.

programme.title: 100 Tula Para Kay Stella
programme.desc: Throughout his four years in college, Fidel, a stuttering student, tries to finish 100 poems dedicated to Stella, an aspiring but frustrated rock star, to win her heart.

programme.title: Asin At Paminta
programme.desc: They are the most unlikely of tandems; two men whose only similarity is their gender.

programme.title: Apat Dapat, Dapat Apat
programme.desc: Four women who swear to be friends forever, become domestic helpers when they go over to another country.

programme.title: Rigodon
programme.desc: Rigodon tackles about secret lives, hidden passions, deceit, betrayal, vengeance, and peeping eyes.

programme.title: Adan
programme.desc: A naive provincial girl finds a way to get ahold of her independence through the help of her girl best friend. But their actions have nerve-shattering consequences.

programme.title: Bullet
programme.desc: He has the mind and temper of a young child, but when it comes to guns, Bullet (Cesar) is as adept as a highly trained marksman. But this very special talent comes into a harrowing play when Bullet.

programme.title: Pagbabalik ng Probinsyano
programme.desc: The small town’s police chief finds his small contingent of native cops threatened by a huge army of security guards and goons who will stop at nothing to get what they want.

programme.title: Bekikang
programme.desc: Bekikang is left and abandoned with a baby boy by friend, Fortunato. He loves and raises the child as his own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Mang Kepweng Returns
programme.desc: When Mang Kepweng died because of mysterious circumstances, he buried with him a secret--aside from his son Zacharias (James Blanco), he had another son named Kiefer (Vhong Navarro.) Kiefer is the heir to the magical bandana that possesses the power to heal any kind of illness.

programme.title: Buhay Kamao
programme.desc: Pepe, did not want anything to do with boxing but the easy money involved in the sport attracted him when he was desperate to pay off a long standing debt. Little did he know that the match was just the beginning of a series of tests.

programme.title: Penduko
programme.desc: Hoping to profit from his occult gifts, a mystic joins a shadowy society and must confront his own darkness as he finds his place in the underworld.

programme.title: Sid \u0026 Aya (Not A Love Story)
programme.desc: It follows Sid (Dingdong Dantes) who suffers from insomnia and meets Aya (Anne Curtis) who he hires to accompany him in his sleepless nights.

programme.title: Hating Kapatid
programme.desc: Hating Kapatid is a movie that teaches us how siblings should stick together in times of happiness and problems.

programme.title: Steal
programme.desc: When money is involved, trust is a big word. Four Filipinas based in Japan will learn the hard truth about money and trust as they get entangled in their own schemes.

programme.title: Warat
programme.desc: Rex (Jomari Yllana) and Rica (Joyce Jimenez) are G.I. babies born to American fathers they never knew. Raised by a rich, gay adoptive father, Rex grew up feeling worthless and alone, Rica was brought up by an arrogant aunt who always makes her feel like she’s a good-for-nothing bitch.

programme.title: Gawin Sa Dilim 2
programme.desc: Traumatized by the tragic death of his girlfriend, Jerome drops out of school and retreats to the province where he opens his own inn. Though still broken-hearted, Jerome settles into his new abode and leads a more serene life.

programme.title: Kid Manalo, Akin Ang Ulo Mo!
programme.desc: His name is Marco (Gardo Versoza) but people call him Kid. Some years later, he finds himself in Manila as a taxi driver. An attache case containing some five million pesos is left in his cab.

programme.title: Mang Jose
programme.desc: Having the ability of energy absorption and redirection, Mang Jose covertly saves people only if they rent him out. One day, Tope rents Mang Jose to help him save his mother who has been abducted by mysterious troopers of King Ina.

programme.title: Baliktaran
programme.desc: A hilarious comedy about a couple switching roles to make their marriage work.
